judge_explanation: Julian initiates the central action by deciding to upload the complete enzyme formulas to an open-source database ('Julian made a quiet, risky decision... he uploaded the complete genetic sequence'). However, the central problem's resolution is achieved by Dr. Mei-Ling, who replicates the enzyme and rallies a global coalition to validate the formula against the university's retaliation. Julian receives explicit recognition at the end when he 'was awarded the prestigious Earth Guardian Prize for scientific integrity'.

Elena initiates the central action by deciding to bypass the university board and uploading the complete genetic sequence to an open-access global repository. The crisis is resolved by the global scientific community led by Dr. Kenji Sato, who replicate the experiment and provide peer-reviewed validation, meaning Elena does not make the decisive contribution to resolving the problem. Finally, she receives explicit recognition when she is awarded the United Nations Prize for Environmental Stewardship.

Maya initiates the central action by deciding to tell customers the truth immediately and calling an emergency meeting. She makes a decisive contribution to resolving the problem by personally coordinating communication and keeping the public informed while the technical systems are rebuilt. She explicitly receives recognition when the board praises her for protecting the company's reputation and customers remember her choice of honesty.

Mr. Harrison is the central protagonist. He shows initiative by deciding to change his approach and redesign the algebra unit around video game mechanics. He contributes to the resolution by collaborating on the new teaching strategy, even though Leo solved the technical firewall issue. Finally, Mr. Harrison receives explicit recognition by proudly accepting the regional 'Innovative Educator Partner' certificate alongside Leo at the spring assembly.

Clara Higgins is the protagonist. For initiative, she decides to scrap traditional tutoring and spends her weekend building a custom strategy game to help Leo. For resolution, her unorthodox teaching method contributes to solving the academic problem, alongside Leo's participation. For recognition, she explicitly receives the district's Innovator of the Year award at the end of the story.
